title: Plasma doesn't ask confirmation to delete a note when using its contextual menu "Delete" option
line: Removing a Sticky Note with text from its right-click menu now asks "Discard this note?" first, like its trash button.
explanation: The context menu's "Remove Sticky Note" entry is libplasma's generic "remove" action, which removes the widget right away; only the note's own trash button ran the "Discard this note?" check. libplasma connected that action to the removal only at startup, to whatever action was registered then, so an applet couldn't safely put its own action in its place. Also, the discard dialog's loader failed on its first use (null item), so the dialog only appeared on a second try. libplasma now connects the default action when it is created; the notes applet registers its own "remove" action that runs the same check as the trash button (asks unless the note is empty or equals the clipboard) and skips it in edit mode, and the dialog opens on the first try.

commits.message:
Applet: connect the default remove action when creating it

The "remove" action was only connected to the removal at startup, to
whichever action was set at that point, so an applet couldn't replace it
with its own one. Connect the default action as soon as it is created.

CCBUG: 453764

applets/notes: ask before discarding a note from its context menu

Removing a note from its context menu skipped the "Discard this note?"
dialog that the trash button shows. Use the same check for the remove
action outside edit mode, and make the dialog open on the first try.

BUG: 453764

media.caption: Before: choosing it removes the note at once, with only the generic "Widget Removed" notification
After: choosing it asks "Discard this note?" first; Cancel keeps the note
Discard in that dialog removes the note, with the usual Undo notification
